function.description: Use for count-only questions about devices discovered by a specific named discovery, such as how many devices a discovery found or whether a named discovery discovered any devices. For named discoveries, first resolve the discovery settings id with api_getAllDiscoveryDetails, then get the latest jobId with api_getDiscoveryJobBySettingsId, then call this tool with discoveryId and jobId. Do not use api_getDiscoveryJobsSummarys as the jobId source for named discovery count questions.
function.name: api_countDiscoveredNetworkDevices

cli.description: CLI status for the IP during the job run. Available values are 'SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'NOT_PROVIDED' and 'NOT_VALIDATED

jobId.description: The id of the discovery job.

managementIpAddress.description: Management IP address of the network device

netconf.description: Netconf status for the IP during the job run. Available values are 'SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'NOT_PROVIDED' and 'NOT_VALIDATED

ping.description: Ping status for the IP during the job run. Available values are 'SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'NOT_PROVIDED' and 'NOT_VALIDATED

reachabilityStatus.description: Reachability status of the network device.

snmp.description: SNMP status for the IP during the job run. Available values are 'SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'NOT_PROVIDED' and 'NOT_VALIDATED

responses.description: Reports a count, for example, a total count of records in a given resource.
responses.title: Count Response
